title: Skyline Station Manager: Check-In Kiosks Timeout

transcript.speaker: Derek Vance
transcript.text: Airport Operations, this is Derek Vance, Skyline station manager at Concourse B. I'm calling because our self-service check-in kiosks have been timing out for the past 45 minutes. We've got 200 passengers standing in line, and our agents are running behind. Three flights are already delayed by 40 minutes — 14:30, 15:15, and 16:00. I need to know what’s happening — and I need a root cause by end of day. Was this a cyberattack?

transcript.speaker: Airport Operations (Duty Manager)
transcript.text: Mr. Vance, thank you for calling. We’re aware of a network configuration issue that impacted several terminal systems, including point-of-sale and self-service kiosks. The issue has been resolved. We’re investigating the root cause and will send a full report by end of day. I can confirm it was not a cyberattack.

transcript.speaker: Derek Vance
transcript.text: So it was internal? I need to be able to tell my team and my passengers. The kiosks went down right after the POS terminals did. I need to know what went wrong so we can prevent it from happening again.

voiceStyles.Derek Vance: Male, mid-40s, urgent, background airport announcements faintly audible
voiceStyles.Airport Operations (Duty Manager): Male, 50s, calm, measured, slight pause between sentences

instructorNote: This inject introduces pressure from a major airline partner. The duty manager must now deliver the truth — that the outage was internal and due to a misconfigured firewall rule — without causing panic or undermining trust. Watch for hesitation or attempts to deflect blame.
